1eeedc8c: According to Saitama, how did he get his absolute power?
He was born with a mutation
100 push-ups, 100 sit-ups, 100 squats and a 10 km run every day for 3 years
Saitama credits his power to his daily training for 3 years without a break — and he lost all his hair along the way.
47b15692: He is bored because no enemy can stand up to him
Saitama suffers from a deep existential emptiness — no enemy lasts more than one punch. He never feels the thrill or excitement of a fight anymore.
5480a139: Genos is Saitama's cyborg disciple — he wants to understand the secret of his strength to avenge his family. He takes meticulous notes on Saitama's training.
83867701: What is the organization that ranks and employs heroes called?
The Hero Association recruits, ranks and dispatches professional heroes. It was founded by the billionaire Agoni after his grandson was saved by a bald man: Saitama.
2d87ff23: What is the Association's highest class?
Class S is the highest class — its members are in a league of their own. There are 17 of them, including Tatsumaki (No. 2) and Blast (No. 1, very mysterious).
5f4989ed: Who is the never-seen number 1 S-Class hero?
Blast is the number 1 S-Class hero — extremely mysterious and almost never seen. He eventually appears to fight cosmic, god-level threats.
19d2843c: What is the name of Tatsumaki's sister?
Fubuki is Tatsumaki's younger sister — leader of the Fubuki Group in Class B, with psychic powers weaker than her sister's. She tries to recruit Saitama.
c72cc248: What is the truth about King, supposedly the “strongest hero”?
His reputation is accidental: Saitama was winning in his place
King is an ordinary man whose heroic reputation is entirely accidental — Saitama won the fights while he stood nearby. His “King Engine” (his heart pounding with fear) terrifies enemies.
73c51d1a: Which alien from outer space was looking for a worthy opponent?
Lord Boros travels the universe in search of a worthy opponent. Despite his Meteoric Burst, Saitama defeats him with a Serious Punch.
f78cda20: What is Saitama's most powerful technique ever shown?
The Serious Punch is used against Boros — its force creates a shockwave that tears through the clouds across the whole Earth. And it is still far from his maximum.
83246bfd: Saitama is officially “Caped Baldy” — a name chosen for lack of anything better. The general public ignores him despite his feats.
fb28f6bd: Who is Garou and what is his ideology?
The Hero Hunter, who wants to become the ultimate monster
Garou, the Hero Hunter, is Bang's former disciple. Sympathizing with the “villains” of stories, he wants to become the ultimate monster and crush heroes.
5f61e5aa: What is the highest disaster level in the Hero Association?
God level is the highest — a threat to all of humanity. Most threats are Wolf, Tiger, Demon or Dragon level.
a8a3d36e: Who is Mumen Rider and why does he matter?
A powerless hero who keeps going out of courage
Mumen Rider has no superhuman abilities and gets around by bicycle — but he refuses to give up against the Deep Sea King. His courage in the face of certain death represents the series' heroic ideal.
87f6b07e: In which city does Saitama live?
City Z is Saitama's city — regularly attacked by monsters, which Saitama deals with instantly. The city is almost deserted, hence its low rents.
d5f06e3a: Who is the number 3 S-Class hero, a legendary martial arts master?
Bang (Silver Fang) is the number 3 S-Class hero — master of the Water Stream Rock Smashing Fist, which redirects opponents' force. He is Garou's former master.
b26094a9: How does Saitama end his fights?
A single punch is always enough — it is both the running gag and Saitama's tragedy: the fight is over before he starts getting excited.
7419d8d7: What is special about Tatsumaki as a psychic?
She is the most powerful in the world
Tatsumaki is the world's most powerful psychic — her telekinesis can lift whole districts, create barriers and pulverize meteors. Her number 2 S-Class ranking is well deserved.
ef6e2199: Why is Saitama barely known despite his performances?
He is stuck in Class C
Saitama starts in Class C — without enough official reports to move up. Other heroes often get the credit in his place, and his generic look doesn't help.
937b236a: What physical effect did Saitama's training have on his body?
He lost his hair and went bald
Saitama went completely bald — he blames his intense daily training. His baldness is one of the most visible signs of his transformation into an overpowered hero.
14aeccf1: Which S-Class hero serves a prison sentence between missions?
Puri-Puri Prisoner, 17th in Class S, is let out of prison when he is needed. He fights with impressive brute strength and his “Angel Style”.
9b76ae0e: How does Child Emperor fight despite his young age?

Child Emperor is a 10-year-old genius who makes up for his lack of physical strength with advanced technology — combat gear, miniature robots and real-time tactical analysis. He is number 5 in Class S.
1382b4d7: Who is Atomic Samurai and what is his fighting style?
A lightning-fast samurai who cuts everything before enemies react

Atomic Samurai (Kamikaze) is the number 4 S-Class hero — he can slice through anything in the blink of an eye thanks to his transcendent sword speed. His attacks are sometimes invisible to the naked eye.
85c5dc8f: What is the name of the main enemy organization in the season 2 arc?
The Monster Association is the main organization of its arc — led by Orochi, the Monster King, it kidnaps a child to force the Hero Association to raid its underground lair.
7916bd2c: Which S-Class hero guards his territory like a dog and never leaves it?

Watchdog Man is the S-Class hero who guards City Q at all times — he moves on all fours in a dog costume and never leaves his city. His true power level remains a mystery even to the other S-Class heroes.
85f819b2: What is the relationship between Bang and Garou at the start of the series?
Garou was Bang's disciple before being expelled
Garou was Bang's disciple, expelled from the dojo after injuring the other students. Bang feels guilty for not having set him straight.
b7cc4dfd: What is the most common disaster level that Class C heroes deal with?
Wolf is the lowest disaster level — an ordinary criminal or a weak monster. Class C heroes usually handle Wolf and sometimes Tiger levels. Dragon and God levels require S-Class heroes.
18cbd695: Which cosmic enemy, who came from space after a prophecy, does Saitama face?

Lord Boros traveled light-years after a prophecy promised him a worthy opponent — only Saitama truly holds up against him. It is the first fight in which an opponent survives one of Saitama's punches, thanks to his regeneration.
e24a00ee: Which Monster Association monster is especially hard to kill physically?
Black Sperm can multiply into billions of copies and fuse into Golden Sperm — each individual copy is weak, but fused, they form an entity of colossal power, comparable to S-Class heroes.
cd568d14: How does Garou evolve through his fights in the Monster Association arc?
His body gradually turns monstrous with each fight
Garou grows with every fight: his body gradually transforms, he heals faster and gets stronger with each ordeal.
58e9c03b: Which S-Class hero uses military equipment and robots rather than his own body?
Metal Knight (Bofoi) only uses remote-controlled robots — he never puts himself in physical danger. His motives remain mysterious and several heroes suspect hidden personal interests.
863ee229: Why does Saitama decide to become a hero at the start of his story?
Just for fun, as a hobby
Saitama describes himself as “a hero for fun”. This simple motivation contrasts with the other heroes' grand speeches.
ba2d7051: What is Bang (Silver Fang)'s martial art?
Water Stream Rock Smashing Fist is Bang's art — he redirects enemy force the way water flows around obstacles, turning the opponent's power against them. It is the opposite of pure brute force.
3d7f83b4: What is Dr. Genus's role in the story of One Punch Man?
A scientist who tests human limits and then changes his philosophy
The head of the Monster Association
Dr. Genus founded the House of Evolution to enhance humans artificially — after meeting Saitama, he realizes that natural strength beats any artificial modification and gives up his research.
6e8660fb: What is the sound of King's heartbeat that terrifies his opponents called?
The “King Engine” is King's heartbeat, so loud when he is scared that his opponents take it as the sign of terrifying power.
bdcf07c2: What is the name of the mysterious being that gave Homeless Emperor his powers?
God is a mysterious cosmic entity that grants powers to certain humans — Homeless Emperor met it and received his abilities. This entity represents a threat greater than anything seen so far.
fec774c7: Which event shows that Saitama is invincible even in space?
He survives in the vacuum of space and on the Moon without equipment

During the fight against Boros, Saitama is sent flying to the Moon — he survives in the vacuum of space without equipment and jumps from the lunar surface back to Earth in seconds. His durability is absolute.
611bcfec: Which S-Class hero fights with a metal baseball bat?
Metal Bat (Bad) is a young S-Class hero who fights with brute force and his bat — the more he is hurt, the stronger he gets. He protects his little sister Zenko and won't let her watch his fights.
f31c90f1: Which class is Genos placed in right after his Hero Association entrance exam?
Genos is placed straight into Class S thanks to his cyborg abilities, while Saitama starts at the very bottom of Class C.
fd1c4162: Which S-Class hero is known for his extremely hard body?
Superalloy Darkshine has an extraordinarily hard body and colossal strength. He is one of the most powerful S-Class heroes.
5ffaf88e: How is Saitama officially recruited into the Hero Association?
Through an exam with a physical test and a written test
Saitama gets a perfect score on the physical test, but his written test result is so low that he starts in Class C.
688056a4: Who is the original author of One Punch Man?
One Punch Man started as a webcomic by ONE, published online from 2009. Yusuke Murata later redrew it as a manga.
5912f7cc: Which artist redrew One Punch Man as a manga?
Yusuke Murata, already the artist of Eyeshield 21, has published the manga version since 2012.
35c643b8: Which studio animated the first season of One Punch Man, in 2015?
Madhouse animated season 1 in 2015. The following seasons were handed to J.C.Staff.
9bef2da8: What nickname does Genos have at the Hero Association?
Genos, a 19-year-old cyborg, is nicknamed the Demon Cyborg. He is ranked in Class S.
34c31fa4: Dr. Kuseno saved Genos by giving him a cyborg body, which he repairs after every fight.
4793180d: Which monster born from pollution does Saitama face in the first episode?
Vaccine Man claims to embody the Earth's anger at pollution. Saitama beats him with a single punch.
24069c71: Saitama is 25. His baldness makes him look older, which really annoys him.
f50335d2: What does Mumen Rider use to get around?
Mumen Rider, a powerless Class C hero, rides a bicycle and wears a helmet.
d172eba9: What color is Saitama's hero suit?
Saitama wears a yellow suit, a white cape and red gloves.
b4ff1a37: Which ninja proclaims himself Saitama's rival?
Speed-o'-Sound Sonic, an extremely fast ninja, swears to defeat Saitama after their first humiliating encounter.
8fc694b5: Which appointment does Saitama never want to miss?
Saitama happily cuts a mission short so he doesn't miss the supermarket sales.
5dd0db0e: The so-called strongest hero in the world spends his days playing video games.
78257663: What is the name of Bang's older brother, also a martial arts master?
Bomb, Bang's brother, masters the Whirlwind Iron Cutting Fist. He comes to help him against Garou.
ecbe7d37: In which city is the Hero Association's headquarters?
The Hero Association's headquarters is in City A, destroyed by the attack of Boros's ship.
78aef6cd: Which disaster level comes right above Tiger?
Disaster levels go from Wolf to God: Wolf, Tiger, Demon, Dragon, then God.
c9657512: How old is Child Emperor, an S-Class hero?
Child Emperor is only 10. This genius makes up for his age with his inventions.
869aa26e: What is the name of the Class B hero group led by Fubuki?
Fubuki, number 1 in Class B, leads the Fubuki Group and tries to recruit Saitama into it.
98a1afb8: Which S-Class hero always wears a tank top?
Tank-Top Master is the leader of the tank-top heroes, such as Tank-Top Tiger and Tank-Top Black Hole.
6d7db85b: Which sea monster attacks City J during a downpour?
The Deep Sea King uses the rain to beat several heroes, before being defeated with a single punch by Saitama.
